top_reviews.title: I LOVE this flatware organizer!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
top_reviews.body: I researched hard for a flatware organizer and had my eyes set on a fancy-ish one, but somehow it wasn't really right. When I realized that this one from Lifewit could do everything the fancier one could do, and better, I knew this was the right choice for me. I saw it on sale and the seller was nice enough to tell me how long the sale would last, as money is tight right now and I'm on the wire with my budget. So, I ordered this on sale and I re-organized my flatware drawer as soon as humanly possible after receiving this delivery, lol. I LOVE the way everything turned out!!! I have my spoons and forks arranged "head to toe," with, for example, teaspoons in one slot facing South and tablespoons in the same slot facing North. Bam(!), it all fits and is accounted for. Even my chopsticks fit PERFECTLY in one of the flatware slots!!! I put it in my drawer oriented with the horizontal slot at the front of the drawer, where I'm keeping my tea accoutrements, such as barrel brewers, teabag rests, and teabag squeezers. One slot is for my long handled tea spoons and some very long skinny paddle-spoons. My drawer is too narrow to use both extensions, but with the one I used, I'm keeping a plethora of straws, plus wine bottle stoppers and they fit great. It's SO MUCH MORE CONVENIENT to have everything right there and more easily accessible now!!! I have a 4"x15" space leftover in the back where I have wine corkscrew openers, a miso whisk, a tea timer, a tin of toothpicks, and corn picks (or whatever they're called. Everything fits wonderfully and I'm really loving this flatware organizer, especially with how well it works to handle my "everyday" beverage things, such as the tea supplies and straws. This flatware organizer was an excellent purchase for me and I highly recommend this to everyone because it fits so darned much and so efficiently!! I ordered the white (which is really a pleasant off-white/cream color), and I also just love how it shows off the shininess of the stainless steel items, too. Read more
